hypothesis: A frozen pretrained temporal representation, unlike pooled image tokens/differences, may expose action signal with a low-capacity cosine prototype head; fixed persistence may reduce multiple-window false positives.
scope: Official TRAIN-only binary proposal and temporal representation experiment, not a type/rule detector
model_artifacts: config/xclip-artifacts.json, exact local provenance and SHA verified before registration
runtime: existing isolated .venv-patched, requirements-patched-lock.txt; no system dependency changes

features.processor: official pinned AutoImageProcessor, aspect-preserving resize and center crop, ImageNet normalization from official config
features.ordered: eight decoded-PTS frames in chronological order
features.repeated: the already processed frame at index four repeated eight times; same processor/crop
features.output: get_video_features().pooler_output, L2 normalized; frozen eval weights, no generated text

supervision.selection: one exact-SHA unit before ordering; fail on TRAIN duplicate supervision conflict; preserve original split and multiplicity
supervision.positive_centroid: normalize mean nearest-fixed-grid point vectors, one per positive TRAIN video
supervision.negative_centroid: normalize mean of per-negative-video mean normalized window vectors, equal video mass
supervision.validation: leave one entire existing TRAIN group out; all prototype fitting inside fold
supervision.classifier_training: no deep head, fine tuning or class-frequency-derived threshold

decision.margin: cosine to positive centroid minus cosine to negative centroid
decision.max: maximum window margin, argmax window center as candidate
decision.persistence: maximum of adjacent pair minimum margins; requires two adjacent windows at threshold; mean of pair centers as candidate
decision.multiple_windows: max is uncalibrated for video risk; fixed persistence is an a priori comparator, no post-result threshold selection

budget.technical_probe_selection: shortest, median and longest unique TRAIN duration; label blind

limits: Center crop can exclude peripheral content
Generic video pretraining does not establish cash-action recognition
Automatic groups can miss scene families
Reused TRAIN OOF is exploratory, not independent final quality
A binary pass does not establish type/rule/evidence relevance
stop: One fixed run; no head/seed/feature/threshold tuning after results. Failed technical or TRAIN gate rejects branch. No TUNE/HOLDOUT inference in this protocol. No deployment or legal event fabrication.
